name: joystream
description: Build, ship and debug JoyStream agents through the JoyStream MCP server.

interface.longDescription: Create and update JoyStream agents, build a version, test it in a Simulation, then run it for real, and find out why a run failed. Works only inside the JoyStream workspaces your account can see. Connector actions such as posting to Slack run as steps of an agent. A real Run, publishing to Agent Universe and setting agent credentials wait for your approval first.
capabilities: Simulate and run agents with your approval
defaultPrompt: Build a JoyStream agent that summarizes the latest GitHub release and posts it to Slack.
Why did my last JoyStream run fail?
